verdict.rationale: Phaser's ecosystem includes an editor and a hosted Game Agent, so in-product AI assistance is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows prompt-driven game building (plain-language instructions, a 'Surprise Me' random idea button, MCP tools that edit scenes). Nothing shows AI-generated insights or suggestions derived from the user's own project or data. Agent-driven building and MCP tooling are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.
